verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Alleluia, alleluia
For the Lord God Almighty reigns
Alleluia, alleluia
For the Lord God Almighty reigns
Alleluia

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Holy, holy are You Lord God Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb, worthy is the Lamb
You are holy, holy are You Lord God Almighty
Worthy is the Lamb, worthy is the Lamb
Amen

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
For the Lord our God
He is holy
For the Lord our God
He is holy

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
He is holy, He is holy, He is holy
He is holy, He is holy, He is holy

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
All the angels cry holy
All the people cry holy
We join heaven in singing
Glory to the Righteous One!
